song.lyrics:
[V1] .G Bm7 Dm G CM7 Savior of my soul, I confide in You, through all my darkest moment . Bm7 E7 C#m7 F#m In you I find my peace, my comfort when I'm weak .Am D I trust in You, through storm and raging sea
[V2] .G Bm Dm G CM7 Faithful, You're my God You're the Glory and the Lifter of my head . Am7 D7 Bm7 Em7 Your light it fills my days, It leads me in Your ways .Am D Forever I surrender all to You
[C1] . G Bm7 Em7 Dm G And I live to worship You, My Jesus You're the only one for me . C D/C Bm Em Nothing will ever take Your place my precious Savior . Am D Who can stand between my Lord and me
[C2] . G Bm7 Em7 Dm G Lord I live to honor You, and I long to bring my life an offering . C D/C Bm E Take me higher, Draw me deeper__ . Am7 D7 G I give all to be with You
song.title: Be With You
